create_mt_collater: create an MTCollater instance with a task config and exclude keys to collate AtomicData batches
collate_atomic_data_batch: call the MTCollater on a list of AtomicData objects to produce a batched AtomicData object
create_dataset_task_map: build a dataset-to-task mapping from a task config that maps datasets to their task levels
add_missing_attributes: add missing task attributes as infinity tensors to AtomicData objects in a batch for multi-task consistency
collate_data_list_with_map: collate a list of AtomicData objects using a dataset task map and exclude keys list
